title: RBI imposes monetary penalties on five NBFCs (Shri Ram Finance, Progfin, Northern Arc Capital, Muthoot MCred)
source_url: Not directly available in search results
description: <cite index="16-1,16-2">RBI imposed penalties totalling approximately ₹12-13+ lakh on five NBFCs including Shri Ram Finance (₹8.10 lakh for non-compliance with Governance and KYC Directions), Progfin Private Limited, Fusion Finance, Northern Arc Capital and Muthoot MCred within a single week</cite>. All penalties were for regulatory compliance violations discovered during statutory inspections.
